payment.bsc.instructions:
💎 USDT BEP20 Payment
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧾 Invoice: :invoice
📦 :items

💵 Product total: :product_total USDT

Send exactly:
:amount USDT

To address:
:address

After sending, tap Submit TX Hash and enter your BSC transaction hash.

⚠️ Network: BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) ONLY
❌ ERC20, TRC20, opBNB, or other tokens are not accepted.

⏳ Valid for 30 minutes until :deadline — automatically confirmed after :confirmations confirmations. When found: :current_confirmations/:confirmations confirmations.

Do not send a screenshot. Payment is accepted only after on-chain validation.
